_meta.purpose: Theme Schema: define the minimal required fields for a visual language (Theme).
_meta.scope: Theme ONLY owns visual language (color/typography/spacing/radius/shadow/component visual style). It does NOT own page structure, region ratios, Page Templates, or content business logic.
_meta.extensibility: Adding Theme 02/03 later only requires a new themes/<id>/theme.json. Template/Layout/Component core stays untouched.
_meta.usage: Renderer: tokens.css provides the CSS variable baseline; theme.json declares semantic overrides. Components only reference var(--token); theming swaps token values, never rewrites components.

field_specs.name: human readable name
field_specs.base_tokens: base token source, default references ui-system/tokens.css CSS variables; overrides must be declared explicitly in visual_language

visual_language.color: semantic values or token overrides for brand/functional/text/background colors
visual_language.typography: font family / size scale / line height / weights
visual_language.component_visual_style: component-level visual tweaks (button fill, table density, card border), never structure
